{{Top|leg}}
[[File:Vambraces.jpg|thumb|250px|Zayne Carrick wearing unique vambraces.]]
A '''vambrace''' was a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueling]] guard that was worn over the forearm, sometimes extending over the hand or the elbow, that allowed the wearer to deflect enemy attacks with the forearm while fighting in [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee combat]]. Vambraces could be worn as a component of a larger set of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] or independently. Vambraces were distinct from [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlets]], such as [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Crushgaunt/Legends|crushgaunts]] or the [[Cortosis gauntlet/Legends|cortosis gauntlets]] worn by [[Imperial Knight]]s, and from armor worn on the forearm for general protection, such as that worn by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]].

Vambraces of various designs were worn throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], sometimes constructed to withstand the cutting power of [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]. This was done by forging the vambrace from a lightsaber-resistant material such as [[Phrik/Legends|phrik]], [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]], or [[Beskar/Legends|Mandalorian iron]], or by combining the vambrace with [[Personal energy shield/Legends|personal energy shielding]] technology, such as that which was common during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. Notable individuals who wore vambraces included wearers of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] made of beskar, the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Warb Null]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Zayne Carrick]], and the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lady]] [[Darth Talon]].

==History==
[[File:GiettKKruhk_JCAOW.jpg|thumb|Micah Giiett's cortosis vambrace|297x297px]]
[[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] were known to wear full-body [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|armor]] made of [[Beskar/Legends|beskar]]&mdash;including forearm protection that also functioned as vambraces&mdash;as early as the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] circa [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]],<ref name="Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 1">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 1]]</ref> although it is possible that they were worn as far back as the reign of [[Mandalore the First/Legends|Mandalore the First]] when he founded the [[Mandalorian Crusaders]] in [[7000 BBY]].<ref name="The History of the Mandalorians">{{InsiderCite|80|The History of the Mandalorians: Exploring the Evolution of a Mighty Race of Warriors}}</ref> Mandalorians continued to incorporate forearm protection into the designs of their armor; however, not all of these were vambraces designed to deflect melee weapons when dueling.<ref name="Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back">{{Film|V}}</ref>

[[Warb Null]], a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] and commander of the [[Naddist]] forces in [[3998 BBY]], wore a suit of full-body [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] armor that was resistant to [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] strikes, although this did not prevent [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] from [[Sai cha/Legends|beheading]] him where the armor did not protect his neck.<ref name="Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising 1">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising'' 1]]</ref>

From [[3964 BBY]]<ref name="Star Wars Knights of the Old Republic 6: Commencement, Part 6">[[Knights of the Old Republic 6|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 6]]</ref> to [[3963 BBY]],<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 42">[[Knights of the Old Republic 42|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 42]]</ref> the renegade [[Human/Legends|Human]] Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Zayne Carrick]] utilized a pair of unique vambraces invented by the [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] mechanic [[Gorman Vandrayk|Gorman "Camper" Vandrayk]]. Camper created this set of vambraces using a [[Tydirium (ore)|tydirium]]-[[phrikite]] alloy of his own design that he combined with [[Personal energy shield/Legends|personal energy shielding]] technology. These vambraces were fully capable of deflecting blows from a lightsaber,<ref name="Star Wars Knights of the Old Republic 6: Commencement, Part 6" /> and saved Zayne's life when dueling his former master [[Lucien Draay]].<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 20">[[Knights of the Old Republic 20|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 20]]</ref>

[[File:Vambraces-Sith_cropped.jpg|thumb|250px|Darth Talon uses a vambrace to deflect a blow from Cade Skywalker]]
[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Micah Giiett]] possessed a vambrace made with cortosis that he described as a [[Cortosis shield/Legends|cortosis shield]]. In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]] he demonstrated its lightsaber resistant properties to then [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[K'Kruhk]], while they were on their way to a mission.<ref name="Jedi Council: Acts of War 2">[[Jedi Council: Acts of War 2|''Jedi Council: Acts of War'' 2]]</ref>

The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lady]] [[Darth Talon]] wore vambraces of [[One Sith|Sith]] design circa [[137 ABY]]. She utilized these to deflect lightsaber blows when training former Jedi [[Cade Skywalker]] in the ways of the Sith.<ref name="Legacy 2006 17">[[Legacy (2006) 17|''Legacy'' (2006) 17]]</ref>
